描述_EN: avalokitsevara), bodhissatva of compassion was one of the most popular figure subjects made at the dehua kilns during the ming (1366-1644) and early qing (1644-1911) periods. guanyin (skt. guanyin was also worshipped as a protector of mariners and as a bringer of sons. guanyin came to be incorporated into chinese religious life, art and material culture as an important figure in the buddhist pantheon and was the focus of devotional practices aimed at individual salvation. it was press moulded and finished by hand. this figure would most likely have been for domestic use and worshipped on a small household altar. this white porcelain figure of guanyin was made in the town of dehua in fujian province, south east china. the workmanship demonstrated on this figure is of the highest quality as illustrated by the fine details of the figure: the delicate fingers and toes, the draping folds of the robe and the combed hair.
描述_ZN: avalokitsevara），慈悲的菩萨，是明（1366-1644）和清（1644-1911）时期德化窑最受欢迎的人物主题之一。 观音 观音也被崇拜为航海者的保护者和儿子的带来者。 年，观音作为佛教万神殿中的重要人物被纳入中国的宗教生活、艺术和物质文化中，并成为个人救赎的虔诚实践的焦点。 它是由手工压制成型并完成的。 这个人物很可能是家庭用的，在一个小型家庭祭坛上供奉。 这尊白瓷观音是在中国东南部的德化镇制造的。 这尊造像的工艺是最高质量的，从造像的细节可以看出：精致的手指和脚趾，长袍的褶皱和梳理的头发。
